{{DISPLAYTITLE:hemostick}} {{Infobox player |id=hemostick |ids=hemostx,hmstx |name= |country=France |birth_date={{Birth date and age|1983|00|00}} |clan= |image= |status=Active |spawned=1999 |role=Jack of all trades |twitch=https://www.twitch.tv/hemostick |youtube=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCWNXCmrbRMZmqH8GuChSCqw |history= {{TH|2020 - |SAF}} {{TH|2019 - |BnP}} }} French player and tinkerer of All Things Quake; has lurked QuakeWorld for a long time whilst playing Quake 3, 4 and Live. ==Information== ===Playing=== The following is pulled from a Quake 3 clan site dating back to 2001, and pretty much still applies: {{quote|Weapon: most of them
Map: anything with shaft
Tactics: give me some
Weakness: getting owned throws me off}} ===Casting=== Hemostick's return to QuakeWorld in 2019 was significant for a scene where media content had been dwindling. He revitalized live coverage and quickly established himself as one of the scene's most important broadcasters. Catering to all types of events, although primarily 2on2 and duel, he contributed to increased interest in QuakeWorld with his humorous commentary and engaging with viewers to provide an interactive experience. Countless hours of competitive matches can be found in his Twitch archive. == Quotes == {{quote|':D'|The answer to anything}} {{quote|''That's what she said''|The other answer to anything}} {{quote|''From all of us here, I'd like to wish you happy Quaking, and Quad bless, my Friend.''|as Shub Ross, the Happy Quaker}} == Trivia == * Writes for the oldschool french Quake site [http://frenchfragfactory.net FrenchFragFactory], hence lurking all Quakes to some extent. * Served as a jack of all trades for the Q4Max Quake 4 Competition Mod, recruited by arQon after posting some brightskin tests on [[ESReality]]. * [[Hammer]] suggested that he start streaming match commentary from reading his jokes on discord. __NOTOC__
